title: Pullback along a pseudo-coherent morphism preserves relative degreewise pseudo-coherence
statement: Let $X\xrightarrow{h}Y\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $h$, $X\to S$ and $Y\to S$ locally of finite type [def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Suppose $\mathcal O_X[0]\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ is pseudo-coherent relative to $Y$ [def-pc-derived-category, def-sfb-relative-pseudo-coherent-complex]. For every integer $m$ and every $K\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ that is $m$-pseudo-coherent relative to $S$, the derived pullback $Lh^*K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] is $m$-pseudo-coherent relative to $S$. No quasi-coherence or boundedness assumption on $K$ is imposed.

proof.text: Work locally with affine opens $X_0\subset X$, $Y_0\subset Y$, $S_0\subset S$ such that $h(X_0)\subset Y_0$ and $Y_0\to S$ lands in $S_0$. Such triples cover $X$. The all-affine-charts criterion restricts the two relative pseudo-coherence hypotheses to these opens. Once the conclusion holds on these triples it holds on $X$: its defining affine covers over every affine base open can be united, or equivalently use source locality. Derived pullback composition identifies the restriction of $Lh^*K$ with the pullback of $K|_{Y_0}$. Thus rename this triple $X,Y,S$ and write $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$, $Y=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $X=\operatorname{Spec}B$.

source.place: Tag 09US, first sentence; Tag 09UJ, affine-chart characterization.

proof.text: The affine-pairs finite-type criterion gives finite generating sets for $A/R$ and $B/A$. Their evaluation maps are surjections $R[t_1,\ldots,t_n]\twoheadrightarrow A$ and $A[u_1,\ldots,u_d]\twoheadrightarrow B$. Taking spectra gives $X\xrightarrow{i}P=\mathbf A^d_Y\xrightarrow{j}W=\mathbf A^{n+d}_S$, with $i,j$ closed immersions, and $p:P\to Y$ the projection, so $h=pi$. Here $j$ comes from the surjection $R[t,u]\twoheadrightarrow A[u]$. These are the polynomial chart and its coefficient base change, not additional geometric factorizations.

source.place: Tag 09US, displayed factorization; more-algebra.tex, proof of lemma-pull-relative-pseudo-coherent.

proof.text: Apply the all-affine-charts criterion in every degree to $\mathcal O_X[0]$ relative to $Y$, using $i$. Hence $M=Ri_*\mathcal O_X[0]$ is absolutely pseudo-coherent on $P$ (the all-degree characterization in [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex]). The closed-immersion exactness clause of [lem-sfb-closed-immersion-unbounded-projection-formula] identifies $M$ with $(i_*\mathcal O_X)[0]$. On $P=\operatorname{Spec}(A[u])$ this sheaf is the associated sheaf of the $A[u]$-module $B$: on $D(g)$ its sections are $B_{\bar g}$. Thus the affine pseudo-coherence criterion applies to $B[0]$ and makes it pseudo-coherent over $A[u]$. The bounded finite-free-model lemma, with $b=0$, supplies a finite free complex $G^\bullet\to B[0]$ with $G^q=0$ for $q>0$. The affine derived equivalence sends it to a complex $F^\bullet\simeq M$ on $P$ with finite free terms and the same nonpositive degree bound.

source.place: Tag 09US, finite free resolution paragraph; perfect.tex Tag 08E7, lemma-pseudo-coherent-affine; more-algebra.tex Tag 064U, lemma-pseudo-coherent, last assertion.

proof.text: Let $S'=\mathbf A^d_S$. Its projection to $S$ is flat by [lem-nagata-polynomial-projection-flat], and $P=Y\times_S S'$. Flat relative base change therefore makes $Q=Lp^*K$ $m$-pseudo-coherent relative to $S'$. The map $j:P\hookrightarrow W=\mathbf A^n_{S'}$ is a polynomial closed chart over $S'$. The all-affine-charts criterion gives that $Rj_*Q$ is absolutely $m$-pseudo-coherent on $W$. This applies to the given arbitrary $K$; neither the base-change lemma nor the chart criterion assumes quasi-coherent cohomology.

source.place: Tag 09US, last sentence; Tag 09UR, lemma-base-change-relative-pseudo-coherent, flat case.

proof.text:
Derived pullback composition and the projection formula for $i$, with $E=\mathcal O_X[0]$, give an isomorphism in $D(\mathcal O_P)$,
$$Ri_*Lh^*K\cong Ri_*Li^*Q\cong Q\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_P}Ri_*\mathcal O_X[0]\cong Q\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_P}F^\bullet.$$
The tensor unit and symmetry are those of the structure-module derived tensor. Both $P,W$ are affine, $j$ is closed, $Rj_*Q$ is $m$-pseudo-coherent by step 4, and $F^\bullet$ is finite free in nonpositive degrees by step 3. Apply the nonpositive-free-tensor lemma to conclude that $Rj_*(Q\otimes^{\mathbf L}F^\bullet)$ is $m$-pseudo-coherent. Derived direct-image composition identifies this with $R(ji)_*Lh^*K$.

source.place: Tag 09US, projection formula and tensor-filtration paragraphs; cohomology.tex Tag 0B55.

proof.text: The composite $ji:X\hookrightarrow\mathbf A^{n+d}_S$ is the closed immersion defined by the composite surjection $R[t,u]\twoheadrightarrow B$. Step 5 gives the required $m$-pseudo-coherent derived pushforward in this one chart. The relative definition therefore proves that $Lh^*K$ is $m$-pseudo-coherent relative to $S$ on the affine triple. Step 1 assembles these triples to give the assertion on the original $X$.

source.place: Tag 09US, conclusion in the polynomial chart.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09US, lemma-pull-relative-pseudo-coherent, with the finite free model supplied by Tag 064U and the tensor-tail inequality corrected as explained in report.md.
